description:
Pick a tea. Tap start. Steepr is a calm tea timer and brew guide that keeps every cup on track—from matcha and green tea to oolong, chai, herbal tea, and pu-erh.

Use Steepr on iPhone or Apple Watch. Follow clear temperature and timing guidance, see the countdown at a glance, and get an alert when your steep is complete.

TEA PRESETS
Start in one tap with Quick Picks, or explore 36 built-in guides. Find everyday favorites and distinctive varieties such as Sencha, Gyokuro, Earl Grey, Tieguanyin, Rooibos, and Raw Pu-erh. Every guide includes a suggested water temperature and brew time you can adjust to taste.

A BETTER TIMER
• Clear timing and temperature guidance for every tea
• Live Activities and Dynamic Island countdowns
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Siri and Shortcuts for hands-free starts
• Notifications and haptics when your tea is ready

APPLE WATCH COMPANION
• Start favorite teas from your wrist
• Follow the active brew without reaching for your phone
• See progress in supported watch-face complications
• Feel a clear haptic when the timer finishes

REMEMBER EVERY CUP
Save favorites, keep a brew journal, and add tasting notes. Tell Steepr when a cup tastes too weak or too strong, then save a personal steep time for next time. Create custom teas with your own timing, temperature, and notes.

STEEPR PRO
Unlock unlimited custom teas, guided re-steeps, full brew history, iCloud sync, stronger haptics, and Family Sharing with one purchase. No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, ads, analytics, or tracking. Your tea library and brew history stay on your device and in your personal iCloud when sync is enabled.

Built for tea lovers who want a focused timer, useful guidance, and nothing in the way of the ritual.
promotionalText: Find your next cup among 36 tea guides. Start a Quick Pick in one tap, or search the expanded library for a favorite.
whatsNew:
Steepr 1.4 makes the first cup faster and gives you more to explore.

- 28 new built-in tea guides, for 36 in all
- One-tap Quick Picks when you have not chosen favorites
- Search and browse the library by tea family
- Favorites are optional during first-time setup
- Small interface and reliability improvements
